decision: Current-language optimized host validated, but not accepted as a new performance baseline. Seven paired compilation comparisons are inconclusive under variable host load; no repeated campaign was run to force acceptance.
configuration: Maintained O3 PGO/LTO builder defaults, frame pointers omitted. Fresh training from current independent C-bootstrapped native compiler. No flags override or profile reuse.

compilation.sample_order: Alternating for two variants; rotating positions and direction for three or more.
compilation.cpu_time_definition: User + system CPU seconds for the compiler and its waited-for children; may exceed wall time with multiple emission workers.

runtime_artifact_proof.scope: Fresh artifact and checksum checks for all twelve existing kernels; seven paired timing samples only for workloads whose code changed.

artifact_proof.sample_order: Rotating positions and direction; identical artifacts share explicitly labeled samples when enabled.

limits: Native 64-bit host. Warm filesystem caches; one build per binary.
C graph uses flat edges and a handwritten map; Dewy uses per-node arrays and an insertion-ordered map.
String equality uses separately allocated payloads; C uses pointer/length pairs and libc memcmp, Dewy uses runtime strings.
Kernel times exclude input generation; wall times include the complete process.
Thread CPU timing excludes descheduling, but CPU frequency and cache contention still matter.

limitations: Comparison host predates recursive values and sibling narrowing; this measures accumulated feature-stage cost, not a single isolated change. Default current 44,005-line build median 318.23 ms wall / 314.31 ms CPU (about 138k / 140k lines/s) on this loaded host; older control also slowed to 314.37 / 310.37 ms. Earlier 238k measurement is not a current certification. Absolute target and fixed reference remain unchanged.
